name: gyrfalcon
summary: MCP server that indexes 1C:Enterprise BSL configs for code navigation and metadata search.

capabilities.label: Serve over stdio or Streamable HTTP
Search objects, methods, modules by meaning
Index data composition schemas of reports
Show extension overrides with both addresses
Detect what a git diff breaks
Read a procedure body by address
Manage help sources via kb subcommands
Serve multiple configurations in one server

steps.command: cd /home/sbx/work && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/aleksandrgradoboev-svg/gyrfalcon && cd gyrfalcon && cargo build --release
steps.purpose: git clone the repository and cargo build --release (about 73 s, no errors)
copy target/release/gyrfalcon to ~/.local/bin so it is on PATH

setup.command:
cd /home/sbx/work && mkdir -p src/CommonModules/Util/Ext && cat > src/Configuration.xml <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<MetaDataObject xmlns="http://v8.1c.ru/8.3/MDClasses" version="2.11">
  <Configuration>
    <Properties>
      <Name>TestConfig</Name>
      <Synonym/>
      <Version>1.0.0.1</Version>
    </Properties>
    <ChildObjects>
      <CommonModule>Util</CommonModule>
    </ChildObjects>
  </Configuration>
</MetaDataObject>
EOF
cat > src/CommonModules/Util.xml <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<MetaDataObject xmlns="http://v8.1c.ru/8.3/MDClasses" version="2.11">
  <CommonModule uuid="11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555">
    <Properties>
      <Name>Util</Name>
      <Synonym/>
      <Global>false</Global>
      <ClientManagedApplication>false</ClientManagedApplication>
      <Server>true</Server>
      <ExternalConnection>false</ExternalConnection>
      <ClientOrdinaryApplication>false</ClientOrdinaryApplication>
      <ServerCall>false</ServerCall>
    </Properties>
  </CommonModule>
</MetaDataObject>
EOF
cat > src/CommonModules/Util/Ext/Module.bsl <<'EOF'
Функция ПолучитьСумму(А, Б) Экспорт
	Возврат ВычислитьСлагаемое(А) + Б;
КонецФункции

Функция ВычислитьСлагаемое(А)
	Возврат А * 2;
КонецФункции
EOF
gyrfalcon build src --out config.db

smoke_tests.command: cd /home/sbx/work && python3 ~/.pickfit/mcp_probe.py --call object --args '{"name":"Util"}' -- gyrfalcon serve --db config.db

pitfalls.readme_said: Скачать готовый бинарь / gyrfalcon build <путь к src> --out config.db (1C configuration export required)
pitfalls.actually_needed: Built from source with cargo (no network needed at build time beyond crates). Index was built from a tiny synthetic 1C dump written by hand (one common module), because the real export is not available in this box. The server needs a built --db file before it starts.
Works once config.db exists (built with gyrfalcon build). Not tested with a real 1C configuration.

pitfalls.readme_said: Сборка из исходников: нужен свежий стабильный Rust
pitfalls.actually_needed: cargo build --release succeeded with the box's Rust toolchain in about 73 s.

judge.observed: The install plan printed MCP and hook configs for Claude Code, Kilo and Codex, the MCP probe reported 19 tools and 'handshake: ok', and --version printed 'gyrfalcon 0.1.25'.

features.note: its check passed, but the output does not show it: The object call for Util returned attributes with count 0 and a truncated result, so it does not demonstrate a full configuration being indexed or a structural answer.
overrides call passed but the synthetic fixture has no extension, so it returned count 0 and the two-address intercept output was never seen
object parts=dcs call passed but the fixture has no data composition schema, so dcs count was 0

client_configs.snippet: claude mcp add --transport http gyrfalcon http://127.0.0.1:8788/mcp

findings.summary: zip: Critical Parser Differential & Security Control Bypass via Dual-Header Inconsistencies (Zip Cloaking) Leading to Arbitrary File Overwrite & RCE
Quadratic run time when checking a start tag for duplicate attribute names
zip: Unbounded Symlink-Target Handling Can Abort Or Exhaust Memory During Extraction
Insecure Preservation of SUID/SGID Bits during ZIP Extraction Leading to Potential Privilege Escalation
ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

evidence: no source file uses ZipStreamReader::extract, ZipArchive::extract; only the project depends on zip

findings.summary: Unbounded namespace-declaration allocation in `NsReader` enables memory-exhaustion denial of service

evidence: no source file uses NsReader; only the project depends on quick-xml
